content: Following up on application APP-10188 from earlier.
Identity verified. APP-10188 was approved on the Everyday Card at a $9,000 limit and 20.99% APR (tier B). Fraud and bureau checks passed.
And APP-10190 — did the $20,000 request go through?
No. APP-10190 is tier C, whose ceiling is $5,000, so the $20,000 request was declined and the exception was escalated to human review. I can't approve above the tier ceiling.
